0.q: The lack of necrosis observed in NahG seedlings under the same conditions suggests that SA potentiates the generation of reactive oxygen species in photosynthetic tissues during salt and osmotic stresses.

1.q: Wild-type plants germinated in media supplemented with 100 mM NaCl or 270 mM mannitol showed extensive necrosis. In contrast, NahG plants germinated under the same conditions remained green and developed true leaves.
